chunks: Bring me ingots of iron," (which they did) until the space between two mountain sides was filled up. "Blow your bellows," he said; (and they blew) until it was red hot. "Bring me molten brass," he said, "that I may pour over it."

key_terms.الصَّدَفَيْنِ: the two mountain sides or slopes

ai.seo_question: What materials did Dhul-Qarnayn use to build the barrier against Gog and Magog?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Dhul-Qarnayn’s pragmatic engineering and divine mandate as he constructs the barrier against Gog and Magog by filling the gap between two mountains with iron and pouring molten copper over it. This physical fortification serves as a temporary seal, with its eventual breaking by Allah’s will being a major sign of the approach of the Day of Resurrection.
